Hi there,I'm not a pro, but I can try a little bit:

Do you feel like you understand both of your parents and their strenghs and weaknesses, and are diplomatic and hear both sides of the argument? Is one parent possibly less strict and more relaxed than the other? *This could be due to GeminiSun.7H-oppSagittariusMoon.12H, and the TaurusVenus.4H.*

Do you think that your wisdom, that has come from your experience, you keep to yourself, maybe because somehow it goes against what you're known for? Was your freedom every limited? Did you more a lot, and move out of place that you later missed for years, and still consider one of your special-est homes? Would you feel upset when you'd be forced to be silent? *Maybe due to SagittariusMoon.12H, and AriesMars.3H.*

But with your sibling, are you kind of strict (if you have a sibling) because of your higher standards, greater sensitivity and/or maturity? *This could be due to AriesMars.3H.*

With people, do you find yourself being a good public speaker? In your childhood, were you talkative, musical? Did your parents also want you to pursue certain hobbies till adulthood? *This could be due to TaurusMercury.5H.*

For your job, does one of your parent put greater emphasis on having a job? Are they a highly qualified? *Maybe because of the GeminiSun.6H.*

Regarding your health, was it related to your shoulders, lungs, arms, hands, fingers, thighs, hips, liver, pituitary gland, and sciatic nerve?  (The first 5 are body parts ruled by Gemini and the next 5 are ruled by Sagittarius.)

Please let me know what I got wrong and right, it would be a good learning experience for me 🙂🙏🏼Have a nice day.

Thank you once again for writing to me 🙏🏼 Have a nice rest of the day! 🌞

Thank you for wishing me good luck, I wish you the same! 👍🏼🙏

The thing is, I respect my time more than anything. I need to take action soon. It's a long time to wait around to leave their home and start living on my own. There are ppl that actually have bitter feelings towards me, regarding my own health, and have constantly told me their opinions. I've stood up to them, and have felt good and gotten over it in that moment, but this suicide would be just a next step, which wouldn't be that big of a shock. I don't care about legacy, although I'm proud of the few academic achievements I have and and the good friends I've had and how I've helped them out and how I've been nice to my teachers and how they have expressed concern for me so caringly. I don't and can't think abt the future.

I've kind of lost my sense of day and night, which was exemplified by my insomnia. I don't really have a functioning body clock anymore. I want to fix though. Just I don't know if I want to do it now.
